english.title: Attempt or prepare to take or fish for salmon in the Tweed district
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[attempted to fish for or take]_
(B)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), preparatory to the fishing or taking of]_

salmon in

(C)_[inland waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), except by rod and line or net and coble]_
(D)_[waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net]_
english.legislation: Contrary to article 22(3) and (5) of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to commit / did any act preparatory to
fishing for / taking salmon
from inland waters / any waters other than inland waters
other than by the methods described in article 22(1) / 22(2)
of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006
